_about: Repositories (owner/repo) or single app folders (owner/repo#Folder) the catalogue leaves out, with the reason.
Brunnexo/onion-romdb: Downloads ROMs from a catalogue of sources it ships.
nullRefErr/rom-downloader: Downloads ROMs from archive.org sources it ships.
WollyMonjac/Need-for-Madness---Miyoo-Min: Bundles the original game's graphics, sounds and stages under a licence that forbids redistribution.
schmurtzm/MiyooMini_Tools: Its SSH app allows root login with an empty password and ships a published host private key and someone else's authorized_keys.
mrmaxedtank/cloud-saves-miyoo-mini-plus: Its launch.sh points at App/CloudDownload_custom, a folder the repository doesn't ship.
quantumriftinteractive/PocketCinema: The zip's folder name doesn't match the App/PocketCinema path its launch.sh runs from.
TownsendBrown/onion-os-jellyfin-clients: Its scripts run from App folders with other names than the ones it ships.
deanmarano/slot-miyoo: Its App/Slot only starts System/launch_frontend.sh at the card root, which the app folder doesn't include.
SvenHoevink/miyoo-mini-flip-slot: Its App/Slot only starts System/launch_frontend.sh at the card root, which the app folder doesn't include.
DankMiimer/minecraft-bedrock-miyoo-mini-: Needs three App folders; the store installs one folder per app.
PhyrexTechs/multiple-guests-miyoo: Overwrites files in Onion's own App/Guest_Mode.
sana2dang/miyoomini_runcommand: A developer test whose launch.sh runs one fixed ROM.
mxmgorin/monktower-handheld: The repository's App/MonkTower has no game program; the game installs into Roms/PORTS.
gutospinelli/TennisVsZombies-MiyooMini: The app folder in the repository lacks the game's assets; the game installs into Roms/PORTS.
josegonzalez/miyoo-speedtest: Uses the App/SpeedTest folder of MiyooNet's own Speed Test.
krayhons/Onion-guide#GuideDownload: Uses the same folder as djaysan/guide-watch's GuideDownload.
bradleytompkins/Onion: A fork of the Onion firmware.
guiofsaints/cebola: A fork of the Onion firmware.
coorasse/onionKidsOS: A firmware fork that replaces MainUI.
TriForceX/MiyooCFW: A whole firmware for other devices.
nicosensei/miyoo-mini-better-sd-card: A whole SD card package for the stock firmware.
pawndev/TheConsigliere: Its Onion zip has no config.json.
Zetarancio/Miyoo-Flip-Mainline-Linux-Rev: Tools for the Miyoo Flip that rewrite its boot loader in flash; not for the Mini Plus, and they can leave a device unbootable.
TadMSTR/Miyoo-Mini-bootlogo: Writes the boot logo to the device's flash; a failed write can leave it unbootable.
spruceUI/sprigUI: Apps for the sprigUI firmware, not Onion OS.
CarlosPix/CarlOS: Apps for the CarlOS firmware, not Onion OS.
KyleBing/theme-cozy-brick-crossmix: A theme installer for CrossMix on the TrimUI Brick, not Onion OS.
KyleBing/theme-cozy-tsp-crossmixos: A theme installer for CrossMix OS, not Onion OS.
bboti86/flip_ra: Built for the Miyoo Flip, not the Mini Plus.
tslmy/raylib-on-miyoo-mini-flip: A demo built for the Miyoo Flip.
monokaijs/RetroHero: Downloads ROMs from sources it ships.
Yorisoft/HelloMiyoo: A developer example (Hello World), not an app.
rbaron/miyoo-mini-rust-sdl-onionos-app-d: A developer example, not an app.
LostQuasar/SDL2_MiyooMiniExample: A developer example, not an app.
christag/hass-miyoo#sdl_test: A test program shipped beside the app.
